senses.zh: 變形（如蒸米糕火猛而變形）

to skin, to remove bark of a tree, to come off (of skin)

senses.zh: 施肥（肥料，糞便等乾固體）

to break partly (as of a cup)
to ford a stream, to wade
to cultivate fields, to farm, to till land, to plow
